text:
morgan: Heads-up, I hit a weird perf + correctness regression when we auto-select FP8 matmul for activations. Symptoms: higher p99 token latency and a small token flip in the middle of long responses when batch>1 + KV hit.
lee: repro steps?
morgan: quick repro:
```
./infer --model redwood-q2f8 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --prefix_kv=on --kernel=auto --prompt-file test_prompt.txt
```
prompt is a long multi-sentence doc that triggers KV reuse. Baseline (pinned fp16 kernel) -> 0.92ms/token, FP8 auto -> 1.28ms/token p99 and occasional incorrect token "together" -> "togther" (single char swap) at ~token 243.
sasha: do you see any NaNs or cuda errors in logs?
morgan: nothing in stderr, but nvtx/cupti samples show fallback to `matmul_fp8_accel_v2` followed by `mixed_prec_adjust` kernel. Perf counters show increased `ld_efficiency` drop and a cache miss spike aligned with KV sharding step.
qa-ana: can you paste the small dump of logits around the flipped token? we should check calibration scale drift.
morgan: pasted snippet:
```
token 242 logits_top5: [ -0.12, 2.34, 1.11, 0.01, -1.2 ]
token 243 logits_top5: [ 0.05, 2.31, 1.09, -0.02, -1.4 ] -> expected "together"
after FP8 path token 243 logits_top5: [ 0.02, 2.29, 1.12, -0.03, -1.41 ] -> picks "togther"
```
lee: looks tiny. sounds like calibration scaling between KV packed path and the live matmul differs by ~1-2e-3, enough to flip argmax for borderline tokens.
taylor: is this only when batch>1? try batch=1
morgan: batch=1 -> no flip, perf ok (~0.95ms). batch=2 gives intermittent flip. So batching heuristic + kv alignment seems involved.
sasha: could be a race in the per-batch quant scale selection. We recently changed scale caching to be per-shard instead of per-batch in PR #8423.
morgan: yep, PR #8423 landed yesterday. Reverting that patch locally -> FP8 path matches baseline logits and latency drops back to 0.94ms/token.
qa-ana: repro script would be great. also add a regression unit that runs the exact prompt and compares top5 logits.
lee: opened issue ENG-2987, linked PR candidate rolls back per-shard cache with comment to add unit tests.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of revert-PR to staging scheduled at 22:05 UTC :package:
morgan: also saw KV hot-shard contention: when prefix_kv=on we get skewed batch sizes per-shard; the kernel selection decided FP8 because avg seq len low, but per-shard peak triggers slower kernels.
taylor: engineering note: we should make kernel selection use peak-shard statistics for mixed-precision decision, not avg. will file a follow-up.
sasha: adding a diagnostic perf counter for "selected_scale_id" per batch and dump it to trace. plz attach traces to ENG-2987.
qa-ana: adding a regression test to nightly that runs with batch=4 + prefix_kv and asserts no token diffs vs pinned-fp16.
morgan: thanks all. I'll attach nvprof trace and the small repro to the issue.
lee: nice catch. :thumbsup:
